name: Alphalete - Website Repo and mu-plugins
body:
> Guide · Alphalete · 2026-05-30

# Summary
A git repo (remotes `origin` = Agency owner, `mine` = user) used as the working space for SSH access, debugging and site maintenance on the Hostinger WordPress site. Its README holds hosting notes and an SEO work log; `mu-plugins\` holds the source of truth for the custom SEO helper plugin; `context\` holds session reports and scripts. The `ssh\` subfolder was skipped entirely for this vault.

# Hosting (references only)
Hostinger, SSH alias `alphalete`, WordPress path `~/domains/alphaletetrenchless.com/public_html`, WP 6.9.4 at the time, LiteSpeed. The same hosting account also serves gritstoneequipmentgroup.com and relentlessfleetservice.com (never touch them).

# mu-plugin: `alphalete-seo-helpers.php` (v1.3.0, purpose only)
- Business NAP constants (single place to update) and a coordinate table for all 44 Colorado cities.
- Shortcodes: `[alphalete_service_areas]` (city grid for the `/service-areas/` hub), `[alphalete_nearby_cities]` (distance-based sibling links), `[alphalete_faqs]` (visible Q&A with per-service default sets).
- JSON-LD: `Service` + `Plumber` provider on location pages; `FAQPage` only from curated `_alphalete_faqs_cache` post meta so schema always matches the visible accordion (same pattern as Summit).
- Auto-inject switches per block (hub, map, FAQs, nearby) via WP options; FAQ auto-inject defaults OFF because pages already have an Elementor accordion.
- Later (per the Oct 8 lesson check) it also carries a business node with a phone number on home and contact, one of the three conflicting schema phones, and the `schema_phone` key.

# SEO work log (May 30 2026)
- FAQ layer added (v1.2.0 to v1.3.0). FAQ copy kept conservative: no PSI figures, lifespan years, price comparisons or cadence claims.
- Metadata fixes deployed with Kim's authorization: wrong-city bleed fixed (Florissant and Franktown said "Florence"; Rockvale hydro said "Ramah"; a Green Mountain Falls title), "Alphalette" typo fixed, "Canon City" spelling standardized, and all 131 location titles standardized to `<Service> in <City>, CO | Alphalete`.
- The FAQ layer was not yet deployed at the time of the log.

# Files (rollup)
- `README.md`: hosting, custom code, work log.
- `mu-plugins\alphalete-seo-helpers.php`: plugin source (described above, no code copied).
- `context\README.md`: what to drop in the context folder.
- `context\session-report-2026-05-20.docx` and `site-audit-tracking.docx`: see [Alphalete - Local Page Build Session 2026-05-20](lib:brain-alphalete-local-page-build-session-2026-05-20).
- `context\*.sh`, `extract-text.js`, `buffalo-creek-9381-elementor*.json`: scripts and an Elementor data dump (no notes).
- `.git\`, `.gitignore`, `.claude\settings.local.json`: repo and tool config (no notes).

# Other mu-plugins on the server (named in later files)
`alphalete-tracking-pixels.php` (WhatConverts DNI and tags), `-lead-form`, `-lead-endpoint`, `-dup-redirects`, `-blog-redirects`, `-archive-cleanup`, `-noindex-thankyou`, `-smtp`, and the sitemap guard. Sources are not in this repo.
